diagnostics.message: The Provisioner manifest references the AWSNodeTemplate named `default` through `providerRef`, but Terraform has no dependency ordering it after the node-template manifest. Create the template before applying the Provisioner so the referenced provider object is available.

The node-template manifest already has an implicit dependency on the EKS module through its interpolation of `module.eks.cluster_name`; the explicit depends_on on the EKS module duplicates that ordering.
